verdict.rationale: Maritime documents agents running in their own always-on micro-VM with persistent storage and a persistent Linux desktop, plus a flat Always-on add-on for agents that must run around the clock. Flat, non-hourly billing also means long runs do not add cost. Default sleep/wake behavior means continuous uptime depends on the add-on. missing for 10: explicit documented session-duration limits or guarantees for multi-hour/multi-day tasks, clarity on whether active long tasks are protected from idle sleep without the add-on, independent or hands-on corroboration.
